s1.syndrome_frame: Acute hip pain with difficulty walking in an elderly patient with a history of osteoporosis treatment and previous hip surgery
salient_findings: Incomplete transverse fracture in the lateral cortex of the right femoral neck
key_facts: 76-year-old woman
One week of right hip pain
Difficulty walking
Received denosumab for osteoporosis for five years
Underwent total hip arthroplasty for a left femoral neck fracture two years earlier
JOA score was 96 on the right and 76 on the left
Initial plain radiographs were reportedly normal
Repeat radiographs demonstrated an incomplete transverse fracture in the lateral cortex of the right femoral neck
Bone mineral density was 0.840 g/cm2 in the lumbar spine and 0.899 g/cm2 in the right femoral neck
Laboratory studies revealed abnormal levels of calcium, phosphorus, alkaline phosphatase, and other bone turnover markers

shortlist.label: Atypical femoral fracture
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of denosumab treatment and presented with an incomplete transverse fracture in the lateral cortex of the right femoral neck

shortlist.label: Osteoporotic fracture
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of osteoporosis treatment and low bone mineral density

shortlist.label: Denosumab-related fracture
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has been receiving denosumab for five years and presented with a fracture

shortlist.label: Stress fracture
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presented with hip pain and difficulty walking after a period of normal activity

shortlist.label: Insufficiency fracture
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of osteoporosis and presented with a fracture without significant trauma

raw.rationale: The patient's history of long-term denosumab use, the presence of an incomplete transverse fracture in the lateral cortex of the right femoral neck, and the lack of comminution are consistent with an atypical femoral fracture.

rejected.label: Osteoporotic fracture
rejected.why: While the patient has osteoporosis, the fracture pattern and location are more suggestive of an atypical femoral fracture.

rejected.label: Denosumab-related fracture
rejected.why: This is not a specific diagnosis, but rather a potential contributing factor to the development of an atypical femoral fracture.

rejected.label: Stress fracture
rejected.why: The patient's fracture is more consistent with an atypical femoral fracture, which is a specific type of fracture associated with long-term bisphosphonate or denosumab use.

rejected.label: Insufficiency fracture
rejected.why: The patient's bone mineral density is low, but the fracture pattern and location are more consistent with an atypical femoral fracture.
